info.title: AGMC Payment Request - APM Payment Status
info.description:
CPI -> CAP IntegrationService. CPI calls this once per APM status message (ST-01 ... ST-16) after the approved payment request was handed over to APM. CPI maps the APM message format into these fields; CAP expects exactly this structure. Authentication: OAuth2 client credentials of the CAP XSUAA instance (same as the inbound create call).

Processing in CAP:
- Forward only by status order; a message that arrives late is stored in the history but does not move the status back (HTTP 200, returns the unchanged status).
- Rejections ST-04, ST-09, ST-14 apply at any time and are final; ST-16 Closed is final. Messages after a final status are only logged (HTTP 200).
- The same message twice (same btpPaymentRef, status, statusAt and level) is answered with HTTP 200 and not stored again, so retries are safe.
- 4xx errors mean the message cannot be processed (do not retry unchanged).

post.summary: Report one APM payment status to CAP

btpPaymentRef.description: Payment request reference sent to APM, e.g. BTP-PR-2026-000022

statusAt.description: Date/time of the status in APM (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:10:00Z)

level.description: Only for ST-03 / ST-08: current approval level n

levels.description: Only for ST-03 / ST-08: number of approval levels N

paymentDocumentNo.description: Payment document number from APM / EBS, if known (e.g. with ST-01)

bankReference.description: Bank reference of the transfer, if known (e.g. with ST-11 / ST-13)

message.description: APM message, e.g. the rejection reason with ST-04 / ST-09 / ST-14

200.description: Processed. value = status code of the payment request after the call (unchanged if the message arrived late, was a duplicate, or the request is already final)

400.description: Invalid message: unknown status, missing btpPaymentRef or statusAt, invalid level

409.description: Payment request is not approved yet (APM messages are only accepted after the BPA approval)
